youtube.title: Got a Raise? Watch Where It Goes in 6 Months #Shorts
youtube.description:
Got a raise? Lifestyle creep can swallow it in six months: a better phone plan, more streaming, a nicer car payment, and your savings don't move. The fix: split every raise 50/50 and automate the saving half.

• 1 in 4 adults with family income of $100K+ don't have 3 months of expenses set aside (75% do) — Federal Reserve, Economic Well-Being of U.S. Households in 2025
• Sam is an illustration: a $5,000 raise is roughly $300 a month after tax, depending on your taxes.

Full breakdown on the channel: "The #1 Wealth Killer No One Talks About: Lifestyle Creep".

📌 Educational content only, not financial advice.
